features: Recording resolution: no limits (depending on camera model)
Remote access via TRASSIR Client, Android/iOS app and TRASSIR Cloud; SSL encryption
Neural-network video analytics: people entering a zone, people counting in a zone (e.g. queue), archive search; offload analytics
Up to 32 TRASSIR Neuro Detector channels; other modules optional
Up to 3 monitors can be connected
notes: Video outputs left out: the 2023 datasheet (G24m3) lists D-Sub (VGA), DVI-D, HDMI and DisplayPort inconsistently, and the 2021 datasheet lists 1 D-SUB, 1 HDMI, 1 DisplayPort.
Weight and dimensions left out: the 2023 datasheet gives 9.9 kg net and 482x550x89 mm, the 2021 datasheet gives 5.3 kg net and 430x380x88 mm.
USB port count left out: the 2023 datasheet gives 10 USB ports (front and rear), the 2021 datasheet gives 6 on the rear.
